lines.say: [warmly, nostalgic] When Nila opened Café 27, she knew everyone. [softly] Every name. Every order.
[gently] Then it got busy. [quieter, wistful] And somewhere in the rush... she stopped knowing them.
[softly, sadly] So when a coffee came out cold... nobody noticed. [quietly] No complaint. They just... left.
[quietly, with regret] A week later, one star told her what nobody had.
[slowly, heartfelt, almost a whisper] Growing shouldn't mean forgetting.
[hopeful, brightening] So at Zavino Labs, we're building a way for cafés to remember.
[upbeat, curious] A QR on every table. Rafi scans... checks in... picks his order.
[warmly] One code. One bill. [smiling] And Rafi isn't a stranger anymore.
[curious, gentle] An hour later... how was it?
[cheerful] Happy? Tell Google. [softer, concerned] Not happy? Nila hears about it first... in time to make it right.
[smiling, warm] Visit by visit, Rafi becomes a regular.
NARRATOR (Julian): [hushed, anticipating] And one morning...  NILA (Maeve): [warmly, smiling, affectionate] The usual, Rafi?  RAFI (Dylan): [surprised, touched, delighted] Oh! You remembered!
[warm, confident] Now she sees who's coming back... and who's slipping away.
[reassuring] She can reach out for Eed, for Pohela Boishakh... whenever she chooses.
[proud, warm] Regular. [softly, smiling] Every customer... remembered. [bright] Coming soon from Zavino Labs.
